props.name: locales
props.comment: The locales to edit, one tab each. Must not be empty.

props.name: defaultLocale
props.comment:
The locale selected first. Ignored when it is not one of `locales`; without
it the app locale is used when listed, else the first locale.

props.name: groupKey
props.comment: Prefix that keeps the ids and form group of two groups apart. Defaults to `""`.
